card.name: Cold War and 1960s US history
card.fires_on: Mostly the marker word in a US Cold War history page: a dash in a list of events, 'by' after 'succeeded', or a word in the 1960 Kennedy era. It also fires on a few stray number or word positions.

modes.label: Cold War event lists
modes.description: The dash between items in a list of Cold War events.
modes.example: Korean War - Hungarian Uprising<< ->> Cuban Missile Crisis - USSR under Gorb

modes.label: Presidential succession
modes.description: Linking word in text about one US president following another in the 1950s-60s.
modes.example: He was succeeded<< by>> General Dwight Eisenhower.

modes.label: Stray dose numbers
modes.description: A digit inside a dose figure, unrelated to the history theme.
